messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle", "pillbug"], "attached_objects": ["small dark horned beetle sitting on top of the head"], "description": "The creature is a large quadruped shown in side view facing right, with the furry brown head, ears, legs and clawed paws of a bear combined with a glossy dark brown-black segmented exoskeleton covering the back, sides, neck and parts of the legs like a giant pillbug or beetle. The bear head has brown eyes, a black nose and short muzzle, with small rounded furry ears. On top of the head sits a small dark beetle body bearing two large curved notched black horns. The bulky body is supported by four sturdy furry legs ending in bear paws, and the arched back runs from the shoulders to a narrow tapering segmented tail at the rear. The underside and joints show tan flexible segmentation with a row of small oval openings along the side.", "extra_limb_pieces": 4, "heads": 2, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown furry bear head with short muzzle, brown eyes, black nose and whiskers", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing right"}, {"looks_like": "two large glossy black curved horns with notches and points, one very long curving upward, one shorter", "part": "horns", "where": "on top of the head arising from the small beetle body"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded brown furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on the upper sides of the head behind and below the horn base"}, {"looks_like": "small round brown bear eyes and tiny dark beetle eyes", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the bear head and on the front of the small beetle on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick brown furry bear legs partially covered with glossy dark segmented armor", "part": "legs", "where": "under the torso, two in front and two in rear supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "broad brown furry paws with long curved dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "narrow tapering segmented glossy dark tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the extreme rear of the body curving downward"}, {"looks_like": "large glossy dark brown-black transversely segmented dome like a pillbug or beetle carapace", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the entire back from the neck to the tail"}, {"looks_like": "smooth glossy dark oval and banded armor plates with tan flexible joints and a row of oval breathing holes on the side", "part": "plates", "where": "on the shoulders, hips, neck, sides, belly and front and rear leg segments"}], "separate_bodies": 2, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
